limitations.PASTA_COOKED: SR cooked unenriched unsalted profile revalidated. Purchased meals include salt/oil/other components; dry pasta availability cannot replace a reviewed preparation/output path.
limitations.SPINACH_BABY: Foundation baby spinach profile revalidated. Third-party baby-spinach lead lacks inspected primary retailer/SPB evidence; generic spinach is not proof of young leaves.

market_semantics: Official chain-neutral listing plus official SPB/LO presence, as accepted PR4 methodology. AVAILABLE describes curation representation, never store stock. Old evidence keeps its exact 2026-09-05 date; no TTL invented.
